title: Shabd Samahare Boliye
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Shabd Samahare Boliye" where he says some words can make a relation strong, but the same words in a rude tone can break the relation. Tone plays an important role.

title: Jaa Ghat Prem
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about Kabir's doha "Jaa Ghat Prem" & explains how love & emotional bond is important for anyone to grow & evolve. He says humans without love is equivalent to a lifeless state.

title: Prem Na Baari
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Prem Na Baari" where he says that love does not grow in the fields & is neither sold in the market. One who wants love has to give up his anger, lust, desire, fear.

title: Sona Sajjan Sadhu
desc: Sona Sajjan Sadhu

title: Pothi Padhi
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about Kabir's doha "Pothi Padhi" where he explains that wisdom cannot be acquired by reading all the books in the world. Wisdom is not knowledge, understanding and comprehension of that knowledge is.

title: Sura Soi Sarahiye
desc: Javed Akhtar explains the concept of brave & strong people & the different masks & defences people use to portray a perception in the society. He uses Kabir's Doha "Sura Soi Sarahiye" to explain this.

title: Bada Bhaya Toh
desc: Javed Akhtar through Kabir's Doha "Bada Bhaya Toh" explains that a person actually grows when he gives back to the society & helps others.

title: Koti Karam
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Koti Karam" where he says, all good deeds that a person does go in vain with a small wave of anger and pride. Anger is like dynamite that can destroy everything.

title: Sadhu Aisa
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about the simplicity of Kabir's doha "Sadhu Aisa" from slice of life experiences in this episode.

title: Aise Baani Boliye
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Tulsidas ji's doha "Aise Baani Boliye" where he says that people should speak a language that makes not only the listener's mind happy but also makes his mind experience bliss.

title: Tulsi Meethe Vachan Te
desc: Javed Akhtar speaks about how talking to a person with politeness & humbleness can make yours as well as the other person's life easy & beautiful.

title: Paabat Bahut Talaas
desc: Javed Akhtar says words once spoken cannot be taken back. They can be interpreted in many ways and used in various contexts. Hence, one needs to be careful and mindful when speaking.
